status: Visual direction proposals only; awaiting user choice. No implementation or native validation.

initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high fidelity Warline Capture match squad-selection design proposal, using the supplied real Campaign screenshot as the authoritative visual style reference, not as a literal unchangeable layout. Other supplied images are existing game portrait art reference. Retain their art style and recognizable soldier/vehicle imagery. Use existing angular charcoal panels, heavy squared white typography, thin cyan selection edges, green health strips and colorful green MOVE, red ATTACK, yellow HOLD, blue SCAN/SUPPORT controls. No generic web dashboard style.
Deliver ONE polished comparison board at high resolution, approximately 2000x2400 portrait, with TWO complete landscape game screens stacked vertically. Each game screen has the SAME landscape 16:9 aspect ratio, same desert town battlefield as reference, same scale. Small clean external board headings above each screenshot, never developer labels within game HUD.
TOP screen: exactly THREE squads available, Rifle 01, Armor 02, Heli 03.
BOTTOM screen: exactly EIGHT squads available in roster, distinct stable numbered squads Rifle 01, Armor 02, Heli 03, Rifle 04, APC 05, Armor 06, Heli 07, Rifle 08. Count denotes squads, not unit count.
Portraits are the hero: edge-to-edge images fill at least 85% of each card; one thin dark translucent name/count footer, slim health line, tiny stable ordinal badge, selected card cyan outline and check. No bulky card headers, empty black areas inside cards, huge text blocks, duplicate enlarged selected portrait, blank card slots or stretched images. All cards have the SAME fixed aspect ratio independent of roster count.
Keep battlefield, top compact resources and objective 'BASE ASSAULT · Destroy the enemy base', compact upper-right ARIA panel with a clearly visible green 'ARIA PLAY' button and next action 'Select squads, then choose a command', small right-side minimap above command controls. Bottom-right colorful command pad with large icons and short labels SELECT, MOVE, ATTACK, HOLD, SCAN, SUPPORT, BUILD, organized compactly to give portraits space. Use same surrounding HUD between both screens. UI legible and touch friendly. These are visual concepts not validation screenshots.
Board title 'A · LARGE PORTRAIT DOCK'. Subtitle 'Same-size cards. Swipe between complete pages.'
Design A: A single bottom-left horizontal row, height about 27% of screen, width about 70%; fixed portrait aspect close to square, holds a maximum of FIVE big portrait cards per page. Three squads: exactly three large equal cards left-aligned, the tray ends after third card and the spare area reveals battlefield; never stretch the cards to fill width. Eight squads: exactly five cards visible (01–05) with EXACTLY same card dimensions as in top screenshot. Small pager above dock '1–5 of 8' with two page dots and explicit large right chevron button. Small summary '1 selected'. No sixth sliver, no reduced card sizes, no second row. External headings '3 SQUADS · COMPACT DOCK' and '8 SQUADS · PAGE 1 OF 2'. Board footer 'Large portraits without a taller HUD. Other squads are one swipe away.'

revisionPrompts.prompt: Edit this mockup board. Fix one fundamental layout flaw: cards MUST have identical large dimensions in the top three-squad and bottom eight-squad screen. Keep TOP cards exactly as they are, roughly 156 wide x 220 high in this reference. Enlarge BOTTOM five cards to exactly the top dimensions, occupying about 72% of bottom screenshot width, 5 cards across. Their bottom edges align near bottom of screen; keep labels, ordinals 01–05 and portrait content readable. Make space in BOTH screenshots by replacing bottom-right horizontal command row with the SAME compact 2-row command pad restricted to the rightmost 27% of screenshot width: top row SELECT MOVE ATTACK HOLD; bottom row SCAN SUPPORT BUILD. Pad height about 170px at this reference size. Never overlap card 05. Minimap directly above this pad. No change to card size when count changes. Keep top and bottom screenshot dimensions identical. Keep all other board headings, ARIA PLAY, resources, colors, artwork, health strips, pager '1–5 of 8', and page dots. Add small cyan selected check on rifle 01 in both. This is a precise UI layout correction; no style redesign.

Edit this mockup board with a precise layout correction. Keep the top three cards exactly their current dimensions about 169x163 in this reference. Enlarge the bottom eight cards to EXACTLY those same dimensions; four columns by two rows, total grid width about 700, total height about 345. All 8 visible, 01 02 03 04 upper row and 05 06 07 08 lower row, no scrolling. This makes the fixed-size-card promise visually true. Move bottom grid to bottom edge same as top cards. Roster header above grid. In BOTH screenshots replace colorful command strip with an identical compact command pad in rightmost 30% of screenshot: top row SELECT MOVE ATTACK HOLD; bottom row SCAN SUPPORT BUILD. This command pad stays exactly same size and position in both top and bottom screenshots. Keep minimap directly above pad without intersecting grid. Preserve screenshot viewport sizes, titles, footer, battlefield, ARIA PLAY and objectives. Keep every card portrait edge-to-edge, minimal label footer, no placeholder slots.

Edit this mockup board to actually deliver visibly larger artwork when gallery is expanded. Keep top 3-squad dock cards and entire top screenshot unchanged. In the lower screenshot enlarge the open ALL SQUADS 8 drawer from about 60% viewport width to exactly 73%, expand it up to just below top resource bar, height about 78% of viewport. The 8 portrait cards stay FOUR columns TWO rows, now visibly 25-30% wider and taller than top dock cards. Minimize all drawer chrome. Header ALL SQUADS 8, 1 selected, CLOSE. Names and health strips small and readable. Leave the rightmost 26% of bottom screenshot unobstructed for ARIA PLAY at top, small minimap in middle, and compact 2-row colorful command pad bottom: SELECT MOVE ATTACK HOLD / SCAN SUPPORT BUILD. Keep objective text and next action visible in ARIA. All eight card IDs 01–08 appear once. Make APC 05 art clearly a wheeled armored personnel carrier rather than tank. Maintain exact board title/footer and screenshot dimensions, actual game style and same desert battlefield. The expanded drawer deliberately covers a larger battlefield area temporarily; this is essential to maximizing image sizes.

behavior.A: 1–5 squads: fixed-size left-aligned dock. More than 5: snap pages of 5; never shrink cards for count. Selection persists across pages; show off-page selected count.
behavior.B: 1–4: one row. 5–8: two rows of four. Beyond 8: paged grid; do not keep growing HUD.
behavior.C: 1–4: compact portrait dock. Larger rosters: dock with All squads count opens gallery. Gallery pages hold 8; explicit Close returns to battlefield. Selection does not issue orders.

designCaveats: ImageGen concepts are approximate, not pixel-accurate layout specifications. A/B intended fixed sizing still needs exact layout enforcement.
C expanded illustration overlaps resource header; implementation must reserve objective/resource safe area, reducing gallery height as needed.
Preserve ARIA Play/Stop, stable squad IDs, existing selection semantics and localized text. Reuse actual production portraits when implementing.
